output_list.criticism: The mintToken function lacks a check to prevent overflow when minting tokens, which can lead to a manipulation of the total supply and potentially drain funds.
The transfer function does not check for overflow when updating the balance of the recipient, which can be exploited to freeze funds.
Similar to the transfer function, this function does not prevent overflow when updating the balance of the recipient, posing a risk.
The buy function does not check for overflow when calculating the amount of tokens to be bought, allowing for potential exploitation.
The sell function does not check for overflow when calculating the amount to be sent to the seller, which can lead to a financial loss.
